name: export-create-upload-submit
summary: Three-stage create → upload document → submit cascade, each gated on the prior stage.

upload_url.description: document-upload endpoint (templated with the new id)

auth_ref.description: auth/credential reference used by all three calls

id_response_key.description: JMESPath to the created id in the create response

notes: Each stage has an evaluate guard on the previous stage's success status.
